summary: This Form 6-K by Ambev S.A. constitutes a consolidated synthetic voting map for its ordinary and extraordinary general shareholders' meetings held on April 30, 2026. The filing details vote results on routine agenda items including approval of financial statements, profit allocation, board size, and election of directors. No special situation such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring is present. The filing is a standard foreign private issuer report providing voting outcomes under CVM Ruling No. 81/22, with no actionable event or deal terms for investors.
